name: cloud-simulation-demo
description: Cloud Simulation Demo using LocalStack, Serverless, React and Playwright

scripts.backend:deploy: cd backend && npx serverless deploy --stage local
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run infra:wait && npm run backend:deploy
scripts.demo: npm run setup && npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run frontend:dev" "npx wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run test:e2e"
